summary: VEON Ltd., a Dubai-domiciled foreign private issuer, furnished a Form 6-K on November 6, 2026, publishing unaudited interim condensed consolidated financial statements for the nine and three months ended September 30, 2026. Revenue rose to $3,779M from $3,228M, operating profit $1,060M versus $1,118M, and profit attributable to owners $408M ($0.24 per share; $5.89 per ADS). The filing includes a $162M listing expense and a $50M gain on disposal of subsidiaries. No transaction terms, board recommendation, advisor, or structural mechanics are disclosed; this is a routine periodic earnings filing, not a special situation. Watch ordinary operating trends, not deal risk-arb.
